sources.entry: Podlive for macOS - macOS client to listen to live streaming podcasts (only). It currently supports all livestreams broadcasting via Ultraschall with Studio Link On Air.

summary.one_liner: Podlive for macOS is a Mac client for listening to live streaming podcasts, currently limited to streams broadcast via Ultraschall with Studio Link On Air.
summary.what_it_does: Podlive is a client for iOS, macOS and tvOS for listening to live streaming podcasts, and this repository is the macOS version. It supports livestreams broadcast via Ultraschall with Studio Link On Air. The README says the backend is a Parse-Server used to store and control podcast metadata, manage push notifications, and save each registered user's favorites. The README says the app is available free of charge from the Mac App Store. Development is in Objective-C, which the maintainer asks contributors to keep to. The project uses GitFlow with `develop` as the default branch.
use_cases: listen to live streaming podcasts on a Mac
follow Studio Link On Air broadcasts
notable: Objective-C-only contribution policy, kept deliberately as a living language
Backend built on Parse-Server for metadata, push notifications and favorites
Targets Ultraschall / Studio Link On Air livestreams specifically
Also distributed on the Mac App Store according to the README
caveats: Only supports livestreams broadcast via Ultraschall with Studio Link On Air
Testing against the backend needs access keys that are not included; they must be requested by email
Setup requires Carthage and git submodules
keywords: listen to live podcasts on mac
